theme_strategy.rationale: Cinematic night stadium atmosphere. Avoids the generic 'green grass' cliché by focusing on tactical precision and broadcast aesthetics.

headings.usage: Use for all major headings, scores, and player names in the broadcast view. Requires tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) and uppercase styling for maximum athletic impact.

body.usage: Use for forms, technical data, player stats, and general dashboard UI. Geometric and legible at small sizes.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Tactical Minimalism'. Hard 1px borders (border-white/10) with solid backgrounds (bg-[#141414]) rather than muddy glassmorphism for the dashboard. Use 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/60 border border-white/20) ONLY for the final broadcast image overlay.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle noise/grain overlays over hero sections and the tactical board to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Replace soft shadows with sharp 1px strokes and 'Inner Glow' highlights for buttons and active states.

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_general: Bento Grid System. High-density, asymmetrical. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
layouts_and_grids.tactical_board: Dominates the screen (col-span-12 lg:col-span-8). Contains the interactive pitch. Maintain a dark, technical pitch outline (1px white/20 lines) over a deep obsidian/charcoal background.
layouts_and_grids.event_controls: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4. A dense, vertically stacked control center for subs, goals, and cards.
layouts_and_grids.broadcast_export_view: A hidden or dynamically rendered absolute container with a cinematic background image. It uses fixed dimensions (e.g., 1920x1080 scaled down) to ensure the exported PNG is perfect. Symmetrical TV-style score bug at the top, tactical lineups side-by-side below, match events ticker at the bottom.

components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn UI (Input, Select, Form). Labels must be PT-BR. Inputs should have bg-transparent, border-white/10, focus:border-primary.
components_strategy.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). High-saturation primary colors for CTAs. Include micro-interactions (hover:-translate-y-0.5, transition-transform).
components_strategy.tactical_player_node: Draggable circular or shield-shaped nodes. Player photo inside, name and number below. Use 'dnd-kit' or 'react-beautiful-dnd' for drag-and-drop logic.
components_strategy.image_generation: Use 'html2canvas' or 'html-to-image' library. The target div should feature the 'stadium_lights' image as a background, covered by a bg-black/50 scrim, with high-contrast text and team shields.

stadium_lights_twilight.description: Beautiful twilight stadium lights. Use as the background for the final exported Broadcast PNG.

stadium_aerial.description: Aerial illuminated field at night. Can be used for the login/auth screen background with a heavy dark overlay.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly set text color and background on hover. E.g., hover:bg-[#1F1F1F] hover:text-white.
motion_and_interactions.drag_and_drop: Player nodes on the tactical board should scale up slightly (scale-105) and gain a drop shadow while being dragged.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up for dashboard elements using Framer Motion.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Never use gray-on-gray. Use text-shadow on text that overlays the broadcast image.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every button, form input, tactical node, and interactive element MUST have a descriptive data-testid (e.g., data-testid="login-submit-button", data-testid="player-node-10").

instructions_to_main_agent.language: All user-facing text MUST be in Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR).
instructions_to_main_agent.tactical_logic: Implement fixed formation presets (4-4-2, 4-3-3, 3-5-2) that auto-position players, PLUS free drag-and-drop overriding.
instructions_to_main_agent.export_logic: The final PNG must be cinematic. Do not just screenshot the dashboard. Create a dedicated visually rich 'Broadcast Overlay' component that receives the match state, renders beautifully, and is captured via html-to-image.
instructions_to_main_agent.libraries: Install and use 'dnd-kit' (or similar) for dragging, 'html-to-image' for PNG export, 'lucide-react' for icons.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (sharp edges for this tactical theme) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Examine existing components in src/components/ui to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
